claim_boundary: Task-free current-frame routing and frozen one-circuit responsiveness only; no chart score, learning, or claim that dense truncated cues are playable.

engineering_assumptions.input_capacity: At most 14 current head positions and at most two current hold tails, matching FD-1 observed maxima.
engineering_assumptions.nearest_head: Choose the visible head with maximum normalized screen position; provide only its current position and lane set to the fly adapter.
engineering_assumptions.tie_rule: Heads at exactly the same rendered position form one shared timing cue; fan out the result to their distinct current lanes.
engineering_assumptions.head_kind: Current rendered head shape labels tap versus hold; no note ID or schedule is exposed.
engineering_assumptions.hold_state: Track at most two held lanes; suppress tap UP for a held lane; emit UP only when that lane's visible tail reaches normalized position 0.
engineering_assumptions.readout_rearm: Insert one 1-ms blank frame after a selected cue ends before changing the selected lane set.
engineering_assumptions.timing_input: Reuse frozen FD2-A8 monotone TTC transform, fixed 500-ms horizon, and 50-ms past window.

cue_classes: partially observed next cue after rearm

pass: Frame bounds and routing are exact and deterministic; one full cue matches the FD2-A8 frozen response; lane fanout emits only tied lanes; a partial cue may be silent but must not emit an unintended lane; two hold states release only on their own visible tail; bounded finite MBON voltage and unchanged weights; exact repeats.
